text: Site blockers ban YouTube. But YouTube is where half of us actually learn. Meet Goal Goose.
Tell the goose your goal. Gemini 4 Neon reads it once and works out what on-track looks like, and where to send you back to.
On every page, Gemini Decision 1 checks a screenshot against your goal in about two hundred milliseconds. A linear algebra lecture on YouTube? The goose is happy.
Drift to a cat video, and the goose notices. Hydrogen writes what it says, and the warnings escalate.
Before it eats anything, the goose's manager signs off. Decision 1 and Neon check that it's really a distraction, and that you won't lose your work.
Approved. The goose eats the video and takes you straight back to the lecture you were watching.
Goal Goose. A focus buddy that understands what you're doing, not just where you are. Built today with Gemini 4.
